name: Side Road
spec: yellow diamond with a black vertical line and a shorter black line joining it from the right
meaning: A road enters from the side ahead.

snippets.back: Side-road warning signs show that a side road joins the highway ahead, either from the right or at an angle.
When entering the road from a side road or a private drive, stop and wait until traffic clears.
Check blind spots frequently for motorcycles, especially before intersection turns or entry from a side road or driveway.
Crossing plates watch side roads, bikes, emergency rigs, trucks, walkers owed slowdowns or halts, and pictured animals by twilight.

If the brakes fail completely, pump the pedal quickly, shift to a lower gear, look for an escape route such as a side road or flat open area while warning others with lights and horn, and apply the parking brake gradually, never rapidly or with great force, until you stop.
A vehicle entering from a private drive or side road yields to traffic on the public roadway.
Signal before moving out to pass and check for vehicles entering from side roads or driveways.
A collision at a T intersection after entering from the side road is one of the listed fault standards.

result.summary: AL snippet states side-road signs mean a side road joins ahead from right or angle, supporting meaning; no snippet describes shape/colour.
